market.question: Will 2026 be the hottest year on record?

assessment.reasoning: Per Carbon Brief, 2026 has ~26% probability of being warmest on record (~56% chance of being 2nd warmest). La Nina has faded and El Nino is forming, but full Super El Nino impact is more likely to push 2027 to record. Estimate ~25-30%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Pace of El Nino development and second-half temperature trajectory.
